root_cause: For opportunity-driven blogs the writer received the internal recommendation as its brief (for example 'publish or activate only if channel gates and expected commercial value remain favorable' or 'SEO first-mover opportunity: score=72.4; CPC=4.33; verify no canonical owner before publication'). The model wrote an article about the publishing decision itself. blogReaderReadyViolations only caught a few exact sentences, so the blogs of 2026-10-25, 26 and 27 passed with internal wording; the 2026-10-28 candidate was only stopped by the P0 quality gate after a PR existed.

observed_evidence.source: powerhouse_content_artifacts, content_publication_obligations, PR #5042 gate comment, daily assert cron 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28

fix: BLOG_READER_READY_PROMPT states that the recommendation and brief are internal advice for the publisher and not the topic, and forbids channel gates, scores, CPC, forecast, search volume and canonical-owner talk. blogReaderReadyViolations gains INTERNAL_PUBLISHING_LANGUAGE (body) and META_PUBLISHING_TOPIC (title); the existing revise and repair path handles a failed check.
prevention_rule: A reader-facing blog is about the entrepreneur's problem or opportunity. It never explains whether, when or how to publish, and never repeats internal selection metrics.

invariants: internal gate and metric wording in the body is rejected
no new scheduler, publisher or table
